WITH cash AS (
  SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) AS net_cash
  FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
rebalance AS (
  SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) AS total_rebalance
  FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
scenario AS (
  SELECT investor_id, SUM(new_allocation_pct - current_allocation_pct) AS total_shift
  FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
shortfall AS (
  SELECT investor_id, AVG(shortfall) AS avg_shortfall
  FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001
  GROUP BY investor_id
),
combined AS (
  SELECT c.investor_id,
         c.net_cash,
         r.total_rebalance,
         s.total_shift,
         sh.avg_shortfall
  FROM cash c
  JOIN rebalance r USING (investor_id)
  JOIN scenario s USING (investor_id)
  JOIN shortfall sh USING (investor_id)
),
norms AS (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN max_net_cash = min_net_cash THEN 0
              ELSE (net_cash - min_net_cash) / (max_net_cash - min_net_cash) END AS norm_cash,
         CASE WHEN max_total_rebalance = min_total_rebalance THEN 0
              ELSE (total_rebalance - min_total_rebalance) / (max_total_rebalance - min_total_rebalance) END AS norm_rebalance,
         CASE WHEN max_total_shift = min_total_shift THEN 0
              ELSE (total_shift - min_total_shift) / (max_total_shift - min_total_shift) END AS norm_shift,
         CASE WHEN max_avg_shortfall = min_avg_shortfall THEN 0
              ELSE (avg_shortfall - min_avg_shortfall) / (max_avg_shortfall - min_avg_shortfall) END AS norm_shortfall
  FROM (
    SELECT *,
           MIN(net_cash) OVER () AS min_net_cash,
           MAX(net_cash) OVER () AS max_net_cash,
           MIN(total_rebalance) OVER () AS min_total_rebalance,
           MAX(total_rebalance) OVER () AS max_total_rebalance,
           MIN(total_shift) OVER () AS min_total_shift,
           MAX(total_shift) OVER () AS max_total_shift,
           MIN(avg_shortfall) OVER () AS min_avg_shortfall,
           MAX(avg_shortfall) OVER () AS max_avg_shortfall
    FROM combined
  ) t
),
scores AS (
  SELECT investor_id,
         100 * ((norm_cash + norm_rebalance + norm_shift + (1 - norm_shortfall)) / 4.0) AS composite_score
  FROM norms
)
SELECT investor_id, composite_score
FROM scores
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, investor_id
LIMIT 10;
